subject: Working shiny app that reads large files, now wanting to incorporate shinyFiles

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: Working shiny app that reads large files, now wanting to incorporate shinyFiles
parts:
I currently have a shiny app that does not use shinyFiles, but I would like to start using it. The ui.R has a text input for the file path, and I open a connection to that path and display the data table. Here's what I have:

shinyUI(fluidPage(
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
            textInput("path", label = "Path to file (including file name)", value = 
                          "...\t_plan.txt"),
            numericInput("skip", label = "Start line", value = 1, min = 1, step = 1),
            numericInput("nrows", label = "Number of lines to read", value = 5, min = -1, step = 1),
            radioButtons("separator", label = "Choose a separator", selected = "Comma",
                         c("Comma"= ",",
                           "Tab"= "\t",
                           "Pipe"= "|",
                           "Space"=" ")),
            checkboxInput("header", label = "Header", value = TRUE)
        ),
        mainPanel(
            titlePanel("Data Discovery"),
            dataTableOutput("preview")
                  
        )
    )
))

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$preview <- renderDataTable({
        con <- file(input$path, "r") #Open a read only connection to the file
        if(input$header == TRUE){
            header <- readLines(con, n = 1) #Read the first line as a string to use as the header
        }
        #Create table from file 
        dataTable <- read.table(file = con, nrow=input$nrows, sep = input$separator, skip = input$skip-1)
        
        if(input$header == TRUE){
            colnames(dataTable) <- strsplit(header, input$separator)[[1]] #Name the columns
        }
        dataTable
        }, searchDelay = 0 # Changing the default delay from 500 milliseconds to 0
    )
})

From reading the documentation, my understanding is that shinyFilesButton() allows the user to browse and select a file. And then I use shinyFileChoose() to access the file (exactly like fileInput), but I don't understand how fileInput creates a data frame of the file and it's attributes like size. Since I'm dealing with larges files, I only want open the connection to the file, and not the whole file. 

I've attempted to use parseFilePaths() but this didn't work:
con <- file(parseFilePaths(volumes, input$file)$datapath, "r") 

what function will return a string of the file path? so that I can put it into my:
con <- file(functionThatReturnsAFilePath, "r") 

Thanks, any explanation of the package would be very helpful
